- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "CLAUDE.md §26.I, `README.md` (Claude issue implementer item 5), `agents.md` (Check-in Loop paragraph, Stale session sweep), and the unreleased `changelog.d/4887-archive-finished-sessions.md` row now describe the new rule" — every operator-facing description of the old "superseded by a later stage" rule should be updated to match the new behavior: an issue-start session is archived only when its issue is closed; a later stage session does not count (#5664).
  Expected change site: `scripts/claude_session_janitor.py` module docstring summary at lines 4-7, and `CLAUDE.md` §26.I summary paragraph at lines 2164-2167.
  Evidence of absence: `scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:4-7` still opens with "Three kinds of automation session are never archived by the flows that start them: `/fix-claude-pr` fixer and hold sessions after their pull request is terminal, issue-start sessions after the `/implement-plan-claude` chain has moved past them, and CLAUDE.md §26.D report sessions (issue #4887)." The phrase "after the `/implement-plan-claude` chain has moved past them" describes the OLD supersede rule that the PR just removed from `classify()`; the detailed rule at lines 57-62 of the same file now says "its issue is closed. A later stage session on the page does not count (issue #5664)". The PR updated the detailed rule and the rule-details bullet in CLAUDE.md §26.I (line 2190+) but left both summary paragraphs stale. An operator who reads only the summary will believe issue-start sessions are archived when the chain has moved past them, while an operator who reads the rule details will believe they are archived only on a closed issue. The same drift appears in `CLAUDE.md:2164-2167` (the §26.I summary, distinct from the updated rule at line 2190) and `scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:4-7` (the script's module docstring, which `python -m pydoc scripts/claude_session_janitor.py` prints and is the canonical self-description of what the sweep does). The progress log records that this PR fixed the same kind of drift at `docs/operations/master-session.md:30` (Q61) after the previous round, so these two remaining summary paragraphs are the same defect class that Q61 covered.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
